method: Five targeted automated audio-to-text checks completed before inventory freeze; canonical captions and named handoffs provide the full source. The rejected evolution-definitions input supplied no transcript and was not retried. An invalid host voice reference and uncertain short interjections are explicitly disregarded. Valid primary voice references only supplement independent turn-context attribution. All selected moves have high attribution confidence after these restrictions, so no additional below-high check is triggered. No direct human listening is claimed.

cost.costBasis: Service-reported input and output token usage multiplied by frozen official rates; includes conservative rejected-call estimate in maximum possible total. Final invoice not verified.

audit.coverageQualification: Targeted clips are not claimed to cover every selected span. Complete canonical transcript and all scope restrictions were reviewed.
